revision.note: WeftFS-Go only; the parent Rust revision and submodule pin were not changed

emulator.version_line: fake-gcs-server 1.56.1 (the binary exposes no -version flag; the tarball sha256 above is the identity)
emulator.endpoint_form: http://<container-name>:4443 on a private bridge network

tests.command: go test -race -count=1 -v -run 'TestGCS' ./store/ in the go court
tests.full_command: go test -race -count=1 ./... in the fuse court
tests.fuse_command: bash scripts/go-object-fuse-court.sh gcs in the fuse court

label: Single-host GCS-compatible emulator on a private bridge network in the OOM-protected Docker court with a memory backend. Not a cloud, multi-node, fleet, device-cache, media, power-loss, or production claim. The FUSE leg is a read-only mount; no writable FUSE-over-object claim is made.
